== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Herta is an assistant and a specialized virus [[Technicians|Technician]]. She belongs to a minor, unfamiliar species characterized by physical features such as an enlarged head, wide eyes, and elongated limbs and fingers. In her professional capacity, she possesses unique expertise that was utilized to treat [[Aila Escalon|Aila]], a role that was kept confidential by [[Doctor Elios]] to prevent complications. Her professional history is so closely linked to the study of the [[Keeper virus]] that her employment records overlap with the recorded spread of the infection across the galaxy.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Herta is a young woman belonging to a minor species. She possesses wide eyes, an over-inflated head, and long fingers and limbs.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Herta is a young woman of a minor species characterized by wide eyes, an over-inflated head, and long fingers and limbs. Serving as the assistant to [[Doctor Elios]], she also works professionally as a virus technician and a journeyman prosthetic technician. Eventually, her likeness is lost from [[Omal]]'s collection, as he can no longer see her picture.}}
